item_short_desc: Rothco’s Universal Hook & Loop Holster offers a versatile solution for securely and discreetly storing your firearm in various locations, such as tactical bags, vehicles, or even on furniture. Designed to accommodate most standard-sized pistols, including popular models like the Glock 19, Ruger LCP, and Sig Sauer P365, this gun holster ensures a snug and secure fit. The concealed holster's loop material easily attaches to any hook surface, providing you with the flexibility to mount it wherever you need.
description: Rothco’s Universal Hook & Loop Holster offers a versatile solution for securely and discreetly storing your firearm in various locations, such as tactical bags, vehicles, or even on furniture. Designed to accommodate most standard-sized pistols, including popular models like the Glock 19, Ruger LCP, and Sig Sauer P365, this gun holster ensures a snug and secure fit. The concealed holster's loop material easily attaches to any hook surface, providing you with the flexibility to mount it wherever you need. An elastic bungee cord adds an extra layer of security by keeping your firearm firmly in place. Constructed with highly durable polypropylene webbing, this CCW holster is built to withstand years of use. Measuring 6 inch x 2 inch, our Universal Hook & Loop Holster is the ideal accessory for safely and conveniently storing your firearm.
